name: eurostat-mcp-server
description: Search and query the Eurostat catalogue — EU economy, demography, trade, health, and NUTS regional data via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

interface.shortDescription: Search and query the Eurostat catalogue — EU economy, demography, trade, health, and NUTS regional data via MCP.
interface.longDescription: Eurostat MCP server providing access to the EU's statistical catalogue covering economy, demography, trade, health, environment, and NUTS regional data. Supports dataset discovery, dimension browsing, filtered data queries, and whole-dataset bulk downloads over the SDMX 2.1 TSV endpoint, with optional SQL analytics over staged results.
